description:
Rank Singapore mortgage packages for a borrower. Returns `recommended` (up to 3 picks, each with a package id and `reasoning`; ranked by the LLM when `userContext` is given, otherwise the cheapest package of each rate structure), `lowestRateIds` (up to 3 package ids, cheapest eligible first), `isPersonalised` (whether `userContext` shaped the ranking), and `packages`, a lookup of full package details for every id referenced.

Core inputs (gather these first; ask the borrower if missing — do not guess): `dealKind` (PURCHASE | REFINANCE); `currentBankId` (required only for REFINANCE — use `list_banks` to resolve the lender name into its UUID); `propertyType` (HDB | PRIVATE | COMMERCIAL); `propertyStatus`; `loanAmount`.

`propertyStatus` depends on `propertyType` — only these pairings are valid: HDB → COMPLETED (resale) or BTO (Build-To-Order, new); PRIVATE → COMPLETED (ready-built) or BUC (Built-Under-Construction, new); COMMERCIAL → OWNEROCCUPIED, INVESTMENT or PERSONAL. Do not mix across types (e.g. HDB + BUC or PRIVATE + BTO are invalid).

Optional inputs (only refine the ranking): `ratesType` (FIXED | FLOATING) and `userContext` (free-text borrower priorities, timeline, bank relationships, citizenship, etc.).

Pass `formats: ["pdf"]` to also generate a one-page comparison document of the recommended set (with per-package verdicts); the download URL comes back under `documents`. Optional `tenureYears` (default 25) sets the document's instalment assumptions.

Stateless: if any input or preference changes, call this tool again with the full updated set — never infer an updated answer from a previous response.

candidateLimit.description: How many candidate packages the ranker weighs for each of its slots (floating, 2-year fixed, longest fixed); values above 8 have no further effect. Leave unset unless deliberately narrowing the choice.

currentBankId.description: The borrower's current lender, as the bank `id` returned by `list_banks`. Needed for REFINANCE deals, where that bank's packages are left out; ignored for PURCHASE.

fixedDurationYrs.description: Optional filter: keep only packages whose fixed-rate period lasts this many years. Pass an array to accept any of several. Only applied when `ratesType` is FIXED.

formats.description: Document formats to generate for the recommended set (currently only "pdf"); the download URL is returned under `documents`. Omit/empty for data only.

loanAmount.description: Amount the borrower wants to borrow, in SGD. Packages whose loan-size range does not cover it are excluded.

lockInPeriodYrs.description: Optional filter: the longest lock-in, in years, the borrower will accept. Packages with a longer lock-in are excluded; packages without one always qualify.

propertyStatus.description: Stage or use of the property, which must suit `propertyType`. For HDB: COMPLETED for a resale flat, BTO for a new Build-To-Order flat. For PRIVATE: COMPLETED for a ready-built home, BUC for one still under construction. For COMMERCIAL: OWNEROCCUPIED, INVESTMENT or PERSONAL.

propertyType.description: The kind of property securing the loan: an HDB flat, a private home or a commercial property. Only packages offered for it are considered, and it decides which `propertyStatus` values are valid.

ratesType.description: Optional rate type: FIXED or FLOATING. This is a hard filter on the candidate pool, not a ranking hint. Omit it when the borrower stated no preference, so a mix of rate types stays eligible.

tenureYears.description: Repayment period, in years, for the instalments shown in the comparison document; only used with `formats`. 25 when omitted.

userContext.description: Optional free-text summary of the borrower's priorities, timeline, bank relationships, citizenship, employment, family changes, etc. Only refines the LLM ranking; omit if there are no stated priorities.

name: recommend_packages

documents.description: Comparison document for the recommended set; only present when `formats` was requested.

pdfUrl.description: Public PDF download URL, or null if not generated.

isPersonalised.description: True when `userContext` was supplied and the ranking reflects it.

lowestRateIds.description: Up to 3 package ids, cheapest first by effective average rate. A fixed package whose lock-in outlives its fixed period is ranked behind eligible ones and only included to fill the list.

packages.description: Lookup of full package details keyed by package id. Every id referenced in `recommended` and `lowestRateIds` has an entry here.

recommended.description: Up to 3 picks. Ranked by the LLM when `userContext` is given and ranking succeeds, otherwise the cheapest package of each structure; fewer when fewer candidates exist after filtering.

packageId.description: Id of the ranked package; look it up in `packages`.

rank.description: 1-based rank (1 = best fit for this borrower).

reasoning.description: Short LLM rationale for why this package fits the borrower.

title: Recommend mortgage packages
